title: Sokel plugin declaration (sokel.yaml / sokel.json)
description: The language-neutral declaration of a plugin contract. Prose guide: docs/manifest.md. An example using every shape: examples/kitchen-sink/sokel.yaml.

capabilities.description: Optional capability self-report: `operations` says whether an operation exists, this says how far it goes. The webhook bit needs no entry — registering a handler is the declaration.

implements.description: What the plugin implements of the platform's capability interfaces. Plain integration plugins leave this out entirely.

transports.description: Which ways this plugin can be reached. Empty = nats (the only kind previously supported).

codegen.description: Generation targets, one or many. Rendering one declaration into several languages is the whole point of this format.

plugin.description: Plugin identity and its user-facing document.

org.description: Publisher namespace; the store identity is <org>/<name>. A claim, not a fact: the registry decides whether the submission really belongs to that org and assigns the trust tier. Omit for a plugin that is not distributed.

version.description: The version a replica reports; the generated new_plugin()/newPlugin() picks it up.

doc.description: **Path** to the user-facing markdown (relative to this file); inlined into the generated code.

docUrl.description: Use this instead if you already have a doc site; do not copy one in.

doc_url.description: The snake_case spelling of docUrl; equivalent.

credential.description: The credential contract, plus how the credential is obtained. The platform injects the resolved fields with every call; a plugin never stores them.

auth.description: Collaborative authentication, for credentials nobody can type in (a QR scan, a verification code, an OAuth consent page). The steps follow from `kind`; they are neither needed nor allowed here.

kind.description: qr = start+poll; input = one more step, submit; oauth = answered by the platform, the plugin writes no handler at all.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes, declared by the plugin rather than hard-coded in the platform.

eventsCommon.description: Fields every event carries; on trigger they are flattened to the top level of the input. Each must exist in **every** event with the same type — the intersection is deliberately not inferred, or adding an event that omits one would silently shrink the common set.

event.description: One event and the contract of its payload.

operation.description: One operation's contract. Business ids must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$; the dotted namespace belongs to the platform (auth.start and friends live there).

id.description: By convention health_check is the credential check: report an unusable credential with ok=false, not by raising.

stream.description: Streaming: reply frame by frame (out.text for humans, out.vars for downstream nodes).

internal.description: Internal operation: never appears on the canvas, only the platform's panel calls it.

timeoutSec.description: Suggested timeout. Declare it for heavy work: the platform default is 60s, and whoever drags the node onto a canvas has no idea what to put there.

timeout_sec.description: The snake_case spelling of timeoutSec; equivalent.

lang.description: Go contracts live in a schema/ package and are not generated from here.

out.description: Output path, relative to this file. Defaults: ts -> sokel.gen.ts, python -> sokel_gen.py.

field.description: One input/output parameter, credential field or event field.

name.description: The contract name, and the key in the runtime value. **Renaming replaces the field** — references on the canvas break.

type.description: The types the protocol knows, plus four shorthands (int / files / ints / strings).

types.description: Scalar union (number|string): variable binding accepts either. It cannot express structural differences — that is what oneOf is for.

default.description: Default value (a default implies not required).

desc.description: Description; when opaque is set this is the **required reason**.

placeholder.description: Grey hint text inside the input (e.g. "sk-ant-..."). Saves the author of a credential one trip to the docs.

help.description: Explanatory line under the field (where to obtain the value). The hard part of a credential is usually not which box to type in, but where to get the value.

options.description: Candidates for an enum: bare strings when the value reads fine on its own, or {value,label} when the value is a code no human reads.

fields.description: Sub-fields of a json field, or element fields of an array (recursive). Mutually exclusive with valueType.

valueType.description: Dynamic keys: the keys are known only at runtime and all values share one type. Mutually exclusive with fields.

value_type.description: The snake_case spelling of valueType; equivalent.

itemType.description: Scalar element type of an array. A file list has exactly one spelling: type:array + itemType:file.

item_type.description: The snake_case spelling of itemType; equivalent.

goType.description: **Names** this structure; a later field may reference the name and omit `fields` — an output echoing an input need not repeat it.

go_type.description: The snake_case spelling of goType; equivalent.

opaque.description: Declares "no structure". Only json / array may set it, and **desc is mandatory as the reason**: "I couldn't be bothered" and "this genuinely has no structure" look identical in a file.

oneOf.description: Structural union: accepts one of the listed shapes. The runtime value *is* that branch, with no discriminator wrapper.

one_of.description: The snake_case spelling of oneOf; equivalent.

variant.description: One branch of a structural union. `name` identifies it, for error messages and the UI's selected state.

goType.description: For an array branch this names the **element** type.

capability.description: One implemented capability interface. The operations live inside it, which is what lets two capabilities each own a slot called "query" without a binding field.
Capability name; slash-joined for a hierarchy (vectorstore/keyword_ngram). The slot is appended with a dot, so the wire id splits on the last dot.

operations.description: The slots this plugin fills. Slot ids carry no separator — the capability supplies it.

deployTarget.description: One published artifact. Compose and Kubernetes are not separate kinds — they are other renderings of a container target.

ref.description: container -> image:tag (pin it) · binary -> download URL with {os}/{arch} · pip/npm -> package spec with version

deployEnv.description: An extra environment variable the operator supplies. SOKEL_ENDPOINT / SOKEL_TOKEN are the platform's and must not appear here.

deployment.description: How to run this plugin's own process. Absent = it ships none (compiled into the platform, or API-only).

note.description: A placement constraint a command line cannot express, e.g. must run where it can reach the NAS.

httpMapping.description: The HTTP request one operation maps to. Path is relative to the access group's endpoint — the endpoint is not in the manifest, it belongs to whichever instance this user connects to.

gqlMapping.description: A GraphQL operation. endpoint may override the base URL: a GraphQL endpoint and a REST base are often different even on one service.

headerKV.description: A static request header from the contract. Set before credential injection, so an auth header can override it.

transport.description: One way this plugin can be reached. The endpoint is NOT here — it belongs to the access group, because different users connect to different instances.
